id./param/scenario/cs/a_170_cs_080.pack|cs_: "Ah, so you are finally awake. Are you feeling better, friend?
"Good, good. You have your companions to thank. Such caring comrades are a rare gift.
"Is that so? Then rest by the fire awhile. When your friends brought you here, you were frozen to the core.
"Ah, but forgive me. I have not introduced myself.
"I am Snorri, scholar of the arcane arts. I came here to investigate the origins of the wicked witch who froze Sniflheim.
"It was luck alone that I was away from the city when she first appeared, or I too would be an icy statue.
"Your friends tell me the Queen has asked you to eliminate the sorceress. I will gladly share what I have learned.
"The witch's name is Krystalinda. Long ago, a mighty mage imprisoned her within the pages of an enchanted grimoire.
"The book was hidden in the Ancient Library, an archive built to house the combined knowledge of all humankind.
"I tried to see the book for myself, but the Library was swarming with monsters, and I was forced to retreat...
"Oh, hello! Up and about, are you? Thank goodness for that!
"Indeed. You are well on the way to recovery thanks to your young friend here. Veronica cares for you very deeply.
"Ha ha! No need to be embarrassed, my dear! Anyway, I had just finished telling your friend all I know about the witch.
"Then I'll get to the point: we're taking Snorri to the Library so he can look for clues on how to beat her.
"It is high on a plateau to the east, but we must go around to the south first. Shall we?
